description.value: Hot House Pizza is a multi-location BC pizza chain with a Gordon Head outpost on Shelbourne Street in Victoria. The menu covers specialty, chicken, veggie, and classic pizzas in three sizes, with crust choices that include gluten-free and dairy-free options. Online ordering with cart checkout is available, making advance pickup straightforward for cyclists passing through the area.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: bollard (2 spaces) at 91m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content loaded successfully and confirms the business name, phone (250-472-3663), and address (#3-4071 Shelbourne St, Victoria, BC V8N 5Y1). The menu includes a dedicated 'Veggie Pizzas' category, a Gluten Free Crust option, and a 'Whole Wheat Thin Crust (Dairy Free)' option, confirming vegetarian and GF offerings. The site features a full cart-based online ordering system typical of a takeout-oriented pizza operation; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM website URL domain contains 'househousepizza' (likely a typo for 'hothouse'); the site resolves correctly and identifies the business accurately, but the URL may break if the hosting is ever updated.
Full street address (#3-4071 Shelbourne St, Victoria, BC V8N 5Y1) sourced from website; OSM record carries only addr:unit=3 with no street address in the address field.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open pizza restaurant at a confirmed Victoria address with an active website and online ordering; useful stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dedicated 'Veggie Pizzas' menu category; Gluten Free Crust listed as an option; Whole Wheat Thin Crust described as Dairy Free
